catholic-encyclopedia-1913-our-lady-of-p: Our Lady of Perpetual Help is the beloved Byzantine icon enshrined by the Redemptorists in Rome. This entry traces its history, its miracles, and its worldwide devotion. The icon that never sleeps: its countless copies hang in Catholic churches worldwide.
catholic-encyclopedia-1913-sisters-of-ou: The Sisters of Our Lady of Perpetual Help are the daughters of the Redemptorist missions. This entry covers their rule, their works, and their houses. The sisters of the Canadian motherhouse: their many works dot the dioceses in the 1870s.
govdocs-archive_org-nsia-WitnessesAlphab: J. W. Masland compiled an alphabetical listing of Warren Commission witnesses. The commission heard from hundreds of people in 1964, and finding one name in that mass was slow work without an index. Masland's list turns the witness roll into a research aid. It remains useful to any reader who wants to move from a name to testimony in the commission's volumes.
nasa-tm-19690020347-the-molecular-kineti: Vacuum gauges got molecularly-kineticked, and this 1969 NASA memo covers Bayard-Alpert gauges. The pages detail the molecular findings. The physicists get their memo. The kinetics were of-gauges. The memo was physicist. The 17 were Explorer. The redheat were modified.
